rules.name: Identity Verification Gate
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be activated until a valid government-issued identity document is verified.
rules.condition: during onboarding or profile status change to active
exceptions: Government-issued ID verification fails due to technical system outage
Customer provides alternative verified identity via trusted third-party service
rules.if_violated: The profile remains in pending status and cannot initiate any Order Request
rules.rationale: Prevents unverified individuals from accessing financial and delivery services, mitigating fraud and regulatory risk.

parameters.name: max_verification_attempts
parameters.description: Maximum number of allowed verification retries before manual review

rules.name: Fraud Flag Suspension
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be used to create an Order Request if the profile is flagged for fraud or suspended.
exceptions: Suspension is lifted by a Compliance Officer before order submission
Fraud flag is a false positive cleared by automated review within 1 hour
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected and the customer is notified of the restriction
rules.rationale: Protects the platform and merchants from financial loss and reputational damage associated with fraudulent activity.

parameters.name: fraud_threshold_score
parameters.description: Risk score level above which the profile is automatically flagged

rules.name: Profile Data Immutability
rules.statement: Archived Customer Profiles must not be modified, and all historical data must be retained indefinitely.
rules.condition: after the profile status transitions to Archived
exceptions: Correction of a clerical error in the metadata (e.g., archive date) by an Administrator
Legal requirement to disclose specific data points to a regulatory body
rules.if_violated: The system logs the unauthorized attempt and triggers an audit alert to the Security Team
rules.rationale: Ensures data integrity for legal compliance, audit trails, and accurate historical analysis.

parameters.name: retention_period_years
parameters.description: Minimum duration data must be retained after archival

rules.name: Contact Channel Consistency
rules.statement: All critical notifications regarding Order Request status or Payment Settlement must be sent via the primary contact method defined in the Customer Profile.
rules.condition: during notification dispatch for critical events
exceptions: Primary contact method is invalid or unreachable for more than 24 hours
Customer explicitly opts out of specific notification types in their preferences
rules.if_violated: The notification is queued for retry; if retry fails, a secondary channel is used with a warning flag
rules.rationale: Ensures customers receive timely updates regarding their orders and payments, maintaining trust and reducing support tickets.

parameters.name: retry_attempts
parameters.description: Number of times the system attempts to send via the primary channel before switching

rules.name: Regulatory Zone Exclusion
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be created if its geographic boundaries overlap with a zone restricted by the Regulatory Authority.
rules.condition: during creation of a new Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The creation request is rejected and the operator is notified of the compliance violation.
rules.rationale: To ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory mandates regarding service zones.

parameters.name: restricted_zone_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory restricted zone

rules.name: Active State Requirement
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition may only be used to validate new Order Requests when it is explicitly marked as active.
rules.condition: when validating an Order Request against a Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected and the customer is informed that the address is unsupported.
rules.rationale: To prevent processing orders in zones that are currently suspended or under review.

parameters.name: active_status_flag
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating the operational state of the zone

rules.name: Geographic Boundary Integrity
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not contain internal gaps or disconnected regions that exceed a maximum allowed distance threshold.
rules.condition: during creation or modification of a Service Area Definition
exceptions: multi-cluster zones explicitly configured as separate sub-zones
rules.if_violated: The definition is rejected to prevent routing failures and delivery delays.
rules.rationale: To ensure continuous coverage and reliable algorithmic routing within the defined zone.

parameters.name: max_gap_distance_km
parameters.description: Maximum allowable distance between contiguous boundary segments

rules.name: Version Supersession Policy
rules.statement: A new version of a Service Area Definition must immediately supersede the previous active version upon publication without a grace period.
rules.condition: when a new version is published for an active Service Area Definition
exceptions: emergency rollback scenarios requiring immediate reversion
rules.if_violated: The system automatically archives the previous version and activates the new one, potentially causing order rejection for addresses in the changed area.
rules.rationale: To maintain a single source of truth for service availability and prevent order allocation errors.

parameters.name: supersede_immediately
parameters.description: Boolean flag enforcing immediate version replacement

rules.name: Settlement Amount Integrity
rules.statement: The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
rules.condition: during Financial Transaction Record generation or validation
rules.if_violated: The transaction record remains in pending status and cannot be finalized until the discrepancy is resolved
rules.rationale: Ensures that no funds are lost or created during the settlement process

parameters.name: total_value
parameters.description: The aggregate sum of item costs, fees, taxes, and commissions

rules.name: Store Partner Agreement Validation
rules.statement: A Financial Transaction Record must not be finalized if no valid Store Partner Agreement exists for the involved Store Partner.
rules.condition: at the moment of attempting to finalize a Financial Transaction Record
exceptions: Manual override by Compliance Officer with documented justification
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the settlement process and flags the transaction for manual review
rules.rationale: Prevents unauthorized payouts and ensures contractual compliance before money moves

parameters.name: validity_period
parameters.description: The duration for which the agreement is considered active

rules.name: Tax Rate Dynamic Adjustment
rules.statement: The Financial Transaction Record must be updated immediately upon receiving a new tax rate update from the external service.
rules.condition: when an external tax service pushes a rate update affecting the transaction
exceptions: Transactions already marked as 'Settled and Closed' in the ledger
rules.if_violated: The system recalculates the record and triggers a re-billing notification to the customer and store
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate tax remittance and prevents revenue leakage due to outdated rates

parameters.name: tax_rate_update_frequency
parameters.description: The interval at which the system checks for external tax updates

rules.name: Automated Dispute Trigger on Tax Error
rules.statement: The system must automatically generate a Dispute Ticket whenever a tax calculation error is detected during Financial Transaction Record generation.
rules.condition: immediately after the tax calculation step fails validation against the external service
rules.if_violated: The transaction is paused, a ticket is created, and the record is marked as 'Under Dispute Review'
rules.rationale: Ensures rapid identification and resolution of financial discrepancies to maintain trust

parameters.name: error_threshold
parameters.description: The margin of difference that triggers an automatic error flag

rules.name: Delivery Proof Mandatory for Settlement
rules.statement: Financial settlement for an Order Request must only occur after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded and verified as successful.
rules.condition: When an Order Request reaches the Financial Settlement Handover confirmation stage
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by regulatory bodies preventing physical handover
rules.if_violated: The settlement batch is rejected and funds are held in escrow until proof is provided
rules.rationale: Prevents revenue leakage and ensures goods are actually delivered before payment is released

rules.name: Dispute Ticket Auto-Generation on Missing Proof
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must be created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a missing item, damaged goods, or lack of valid timestamp/signature.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Proof is submitted with indicators of delivery failure or discrepancy
rules.if_violated: The Order Request remains in a pending state, blocking closure and potentially causing customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Ensures rapid response to delivery failures and initiates the resolution workflow

parameters.name: dispute_trigger_threshold
parameters.description: Criteria defining what constitutes a delivery exception

rules.name: Delivery Proof Rejection for Cancelled Assignments
rules.statement: A Delivery Proof must not be accepted or processed if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Partner attempts to submit a Delivery Proof for an Order Request
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the submission and logs an error, preventing false settlement triggers
rules.rationale: Prevents fraudulent claims or errors where goods were never assigned for delivery

parameters.name: assignment_status
parameters.description: Current status of the Delivery Assignment (e.g., cancelled, active)

rules.name: Delivery Partner Score Update on Proof Submission
rules.statement: A Delivery Partner's performance score must be updated immediately upon the submission of a Delivery Proof record.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Proof is successfully submitted and validated
rules.if_violated: The partner's performance metrics remain stale, affecting future order allocation and compensation
rules.rationale: Ensures real-time accuracy of partner performance metrics for routing and incentive calculations

parameters.name: score_update_latency
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed between proof submission and score recalculation
